git status --short && cat docs/README.md notes/issue-12.md docs/architecture.md docs/adrs/README.md docs/adrs/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md docs/glossary.md

git diff --check && git diff --stat && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
paths = [Path('docs/adrs/0002-run-background-jobs-on-postgres.md'), Path('docs/adrs/README.md'), Path('docs/architecture.md')]
for path in paths:
    content = path.read_text()
    assert '[[fill:' not in content, path
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', content):
        filename, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        destination = path.parent / filename
        assert destination.is_file(), (path, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+ (.+)$', destination.read_text(), re.M)
            slugs = [re.sub(r'[^\w\s-]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings]
            assert anchor in slugs, (path, target)
adr = paths[0].read_text()
assert re.findall(r'^## (.+)$', adr, re.M) == ['Context', 'Options', 'Decision', 'Consequences']
print('Documentation links, ADR sections and placeholders checked.')
PY
